event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
FRA 223120 was represented by Capucine Deltel.
The race committee was represented by Ewa Jodlowska (Course Race Officer Area A).
Pierre Gueguen (coach of FRA 223110) attended the hearing as an interpreter for FRA 223110.
Max Pawloski (race officer at the pin end vessel on race area A) presented evidence, including video evidence, during the hearing.
Before the hearing, FRA 223120 went to the race committee and asked to review the video of the start of race 9.
facts: In race 9 (F3) of the ILCA 4 Girls gold fleet, flag U was used as the preparatory signal.
Two - three seconds before the starting signal of the race, FRA 223120 was inside the triangle formed by the ends of the line and the first mark, close to the pin end.
FRA 223120 was identified both by the race committee starting vessel and by the pin end vessel of the starting line.
FRA 223120 was scored UFD in race 9 (F3).
conclusions: By scoring FRA 223120 who was identified inside the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal as UFD, the race committee did not do an improper action or omission. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
decision: Redress is not given to FRA 223120.
